selection_semantics: manual purposive metadata location after viewing existing metadata, before new bodies; not a preregistered automatic ranking, random sample or prevalence estimate
source_collection: Collect exact single-parent original bytes/blob and finite declared docs; no child message/diff until parent predictions, checker outputs or skipped reasons are saved. No existing model assessments or raw replies read. No deleting GNU/macros/branches for parser support.
qualification: Scope and contact truth separate from parser support. Qualified independent unknown cases stay in denominator; H is source-position exposed development transfer and never independent. A possible normal must have same common use, not disabled feature/no warning.
model: Current Windows native Claude Code2.1.301 + AWS-Claude-Opus-5.5 via ISRC Anthropic Messages; credentials outside repo, subprocess memory/env only. Fresh parent tasks, no refusal recovery. Input excludes titles, screening labels, child/fix/oracle and researcher target predicates.
method: Reuse unchanged N2.7 schema and N2.6 raw adapter plus registered pure contract/contrast components; no new parser/CFG/effect support. Any provided semantic role/authority is manual and not automatic. Raw-source limitations remain; no runtime/configuration claims.
budget: Tasks may be sequential; second only if max(reservation, visible counters) plus next reservation remains <=1M. Internal recovery/billing unknown. Visible counters and reservation not added; preserve incomplete/refused outputs without reading refused final.
post_prediction: Independent role may read selected children after predictions/failures/skips are saved, then judge same-mechanism, normative authority, causal scope, normal status and source exposure. No replacement or reclassification to improve supported subset.
exit: Finish bounded qualification, adequate parent model trial/check and post-hoc scope review in one batch. Preserve insufficiency and remaining conditions; no full-tree audit or frontend expansion. R3 deferred; no Word changes or push.
